title: Cytotoxicity of Pd(II) and Pt(II) complexes of 2′,6′-di(thiazol-2-yl)-2,4′-bipyridine: insights into the mode of cell death and cell cycle arrest
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12057-12066
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00647C, Paper
Open Access

Ahmed M. Mansour, Krzysztof Radacki, Ola R. Shehab, Gamal A. E. Mostafa, Essam A. Ali, Mahmoud T. Abo-Elfadl
The fluorescent-stain photos of the treated HCT-116 cells with the Pd(II) complex of 2′,6′-di(thiazol-2-yl)-2,4′-bipyridine showed increased apoptotic bodies, indicating both early (18%) and late apoptosis (32%) as well as a necrosis ratio of about 10%.
